Title: Stuart Little 3: Call of the Wild
Writer: E.B. White (based on characters from the book by), Douglas Wick (story by), Bob Shaw (screenplay by), Don McEnery (screenplay by), Bill Motz (additional writing), Bob Roth (additional writing)

Plot: The Little family spend their vacation near Lake Garland. Meanwhile, in the forest, a beast is threatening the animals to give her food every night.
